allowed_actions.menu_label: Submit one aggregate request for required review.

Hold for aggregate review + obtain required higher approval (single aggregate packet)

allowed_actions.menu_label: Request exception authority determination (if applicable) and pause payment until resolved

allowed_actions.menu_label: Corrective triage: flag as potential structured split and escalate to reviewer/approver for consolidation decision
allowed_actions.selection_boundary: Add a structured-split risk flag (based on visible relatedness and aggregate over threshold) and escalate for a consolidation/approval-path decision before proceeding.
